tei:titleStmt.tei:title: A prayer for the recovery of Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg (2018)

tei:div.tei:head: A prayer for the recovery of Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg (2018)

tei:lg.tei:l: Nefesh kol ḥai (Spirit of All Life)
binding us all together as one,
please strengthen the vitality of Yita Rokhl bat Tsirl Leah.
May my love and concern for her health
be counted among the prayers of all compassionate peoples
and the prayers of your people of Yisrael
to be received before the throne of your resplendent spirit,
that you may restore her in complete and vibrant health
and that she may continue to perform her holy work for justice,
as is proclaimed in your teaching:
(“Justice, Justice shall you pursue that you may live”) —
And so may she live in good health of body mind and spirit

tei:note.tei:p: Cf. the blessing Borei Nefashot: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם בּוֹרֵא נְפָשׁוֹת רַבּוֹת וְחֶסְרוֹנָן עַל כָּל מַה שֵּׁבָּרָאתָ לְהַחֲיוֹת בָּהֶם נֶֽפֶשׁ כָּל חָי: בָּרוּךְ חַי הָעוֹלָמִים: (“Blessed are you, YHVH our elo’ah, Cosmic Majesty, who creates a diverse multitude of creatures, each with a dependency (lit. absence) through which it is enlivened with the Spirit of Life. Blessed is the Life of the Worlds.”)
